summary: Boyd Group Services Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer trading on TSX (BYD) and NYSE (BGSI), filed a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026 furnishing a press release announcing its regular third-quarter 2026 cash dividend of C$0.156 per common share, payable October 28, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. Non-resident shareholders are subject to Canadian withholding taxes. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond the payment timetable are disclosed. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
